snippet.title: Sky Homestead — Official Trailer | Cozy Farming & Automation on Floating Islands
snippet.description:
The islands went quiet three hundred years ago. Time to light them back up.

🎈 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4974230 

Sky Homestead is a cozy farming & automation game set on a chain of floating islands. Start with an axe and a torn-up homestead — end with a sky-spanning empire.

🌱 Farm your way: till, plant, and water fifteen crops across three tiers
⚙️ Build real production lines — furnaces, crafters, and a crystal-powered grid
🤝 Hire a crew of little workers who chop, mine, farm, and haul while you explore
🎈 Charter cargo balloons and drones to run freight between islands
🗡️ Descend into the Deep — a procedurally built dungeon under the old world
🌉 Restore the bridges and wake seven very different islands, from snowfields to a live volcano

Solo-developed. Coming in 2027.

#cozygames #farmingsim #automation #indiegame
